title: LRU Cache
description: Write a Zig program that simulates an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache with a fixed capacity.
hints: LRU cache evicts the least recently used item when capacity is reached
Use an array of structs with key-value pairs
Shift elements when accessing or adding to maintain recency order
The most recent items should be at the end of the array
